Weighted ridge regression with a canonical link

Source: R/initial_values.R
ridge_glm.Rd

Maximises sum(w * loglik(y | X beta)) - lambda / 2 * sum(beta^2) by Newton steps with step halving, for the Gaussian (identity link), Poisson (log link) and binomial (logit link, y a proportion of one trial) families.

Usage

ridge_glm(X, y, w, family, lambda = 0.001)

Arguments

X

Design matrix

y

Outcome

w

Non-negative observation weights

family

"gaussian", "poisson" or "binomial"

lambda

Ridge penalty

Value

Coefficient vector
